description: Test suite for the HeadersPayloadDecoder in HTTP/2 frame decoding, including various payload sizes, padding, and error conditions.

classes.name: HeadersPayloadDecoderPeer
classes.description: Provides static methods to identify frame type and flags affecting payload decoding for HEADERS frames.

classes.name: Listener
classes.description: Test listener that handles all expected On* methods during decoding, recording events and errors.

classes.name: HeadersPayloadDecoderTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing HeadersPayloadDecoder with various scenarios.

methods.name: HeadersPayloadDecoderPeer::FrameType
methods.description: Returns the frame type for HEADERS.

methods.name: HeadersPayloadDecoderPeer::FlagsAffectingPayloadDecoding
methods.description: Returns flags that affect payload decoding (PADDED and PRIORITY).

methods.name: Listener::OnHeadersStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a headers frame.

methods.name: Listener::OnHeadersPriority
methods.description: Handles priority information in headers frame.

methods.name: Listener::OnPaddingTooLong
methods.description: Handles error when padding is too long.

methods.name: HeadersPayloadDecoderTest::VariousHpackPayloadSizes
methods.description: Test decoding of various HPACK payload sizes with optional priority.

methods.name: HeadersPayloadDecoderTest::Truncated
methods.description: Test detection of errors when PRIORITY flag is set but payload is too short.

methods.name: HeadersPayloadDecoderTest::PaddingTooLong
methods.description: Test detection of padding length errors.
